name: pumi-pane-switcher
description: Alt-Tab for panes: a row of cards, each showing what its pane holds, to pick one.

trigger.label: Trigger
trigger.desc: The key that opens the switcher, from any pane. Option-Tab on a Mac; a chord such as <C-Space> works too.

scope.label: Which panes
scope.desc: The panes the switcher shows: the tab's, the session's (every tab), or every session's.

order.label: Order
order.desc: How the cards are ordered. Recently used puts the last pane first, as a task switcher does.

width.label: Width
width.desc: How much of the window's width the switcher takes.

backdrop.label: Dim behind it
backdrop.desc: How much the switcher dims the window under it, and takes the presses there: a press outside closes it.

height.label: Height
height.desc: How many terminal rows tall the switcher is.

card_width.label: Card width
card_width.desc: How wide one pane's card is.

preview.label: Show pane text
preview.desc: Draw each pane's screen in its card, as a task switcher shows a window. Off makes the cards just their titles.

preview_rows.label: Preview lines
preview_rows.desc: How many lines tall the screen a card shows is. The app's own screen of the pane is drawn whole, scaled to that box.
